title: Data and code for "Ground-to-canopy tree methane fluxes: Implications for scaling and forest budgets"
description: Field CO2 and CH4 flux data and R code for Gewirtzman et al., "Ground-to-canopy tree methane fluxes: Implications for scaling and forest budgets" (submitted to Geophysical Research Letters). data/ holds the raw analyzer files, one metadata table per site (one row per chamber closure, with its measurement window), leaf areas, weather and photographs; flux/ fits fluxes and detection limits; scaling/ runs the extrapolation tests and scaling scenarios; figures/ holds Figures 1-3 and S1-S6. The data cover 136 closures on stems, branches and leaves of seven trees at Harvard Forest (MA, 2023; up to 22 m), nine stem closures on a black oak at Yale Myers Forest (CT, 2022) and 105 repeated stem closures on a reference black gum (Nyssa sylvatica) in the Black Gum Swamp at Harvard Forest (2024). Run Rscript run_analysis.R; see README.md, data/README.md and docs/REPRODUCING.md. Soil CH4 fluxes (Jevon, 2023) are distributed separately.
